POWER RESTORATION UPDATE
Affected Areas: Portion of BF3 - Residencia Royale, Golden Gate Hills Subd., Alunan  Relocation Site, Alangilan Proper, Alangilan Nat'l HS, Arceo ES, Buro-Buro Resort, Bocal-bocal Resort, Hda. (Hermilinda, Carmen, Bantug, Garcia, Claudio, Bendito), Sitio (Masangcad-Cabatangan, Balogo-Concepcion, Arceo), Purok 12 Kabutungan. and 
Portion of BF3 - Hda. Rosario, Hda. Conchita, Prk. 8 Pinaya-on, Granada Hts, Emiliano Lizares High sch., Police Station 5, Granada Proper to Asuncion Lizares Elem Sch., Glendale Homes, Sitio Mirasol, Stone Haven, Prk Balabag, Charito Hts.
Restored at 2:34PM
We are pleased to inform our valued consumers that our dedicated team has successfully restored power to the affected areas of today’s scheduled power interruption. This achievement comes ahead of our projected schedule.
We extend our sincere gratitude for your patience, understanding, and continued support throughout the restoration efforts. Your cooperation played a vital role in enabling our teams to work efficiently and safely in the field.
If you are still experiencing a power outage, please do not hesitate to reach out to us. Kindly send your account details and contact number, so we can assist you as soon as possible.
Thank you once again for bearing with us. We remain committed to delivering reliable and improved electric service to our community.
SERVICE BEYOND POWER
#NegrosPowerRehab
#PadayonAngRehabilitasyon
#ForBetterElectricService

SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: OCTOBER 10, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa October 10, 2026 (Saturday)
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: October 10, 2026 (Saturday)
Reason: 
● Reconductoring of 0.6km 3-phase primary line to #336.4 Aluminum Conductor Steel-Reinforced tree wire;
● Reconductoring 1.2km 1-phase primary to 4/0 tree wire; and
● Relocation of 5 primary concrete poles due to DPWH road Row widening.
Time & Affected Areas:
6:00AM to 7:00AM & 5:00PM to 6:00PM
Portion of BF3 - Hda. Rosario, Hda. Conchita, Prk. 8 Pinaya-on, Granada Hts, Emiliano Lizares High sch., Police Station 5, Granada Proper to Asuncion Lizares Elem Sch., Glendale Homes, Sitio Mirasol, Stone Haven, Prk Balabag, Charito Hts.
6:00AM to 6:00PM
Portion of BF3 - Residencia Royale, Golden Gate Hills Subd., Alunan  Relocation Site, Alangilan Proper, Alangilan Nat'l HS, Arceo ES, Buro-Buro Resort, Bocal-bocal Resort, Hda. (Hermilinda, Carmen, Bantug, Garcia, Claudio, Bendito), Sitio (Masangcad-Cabatangan, Balogo-Concepcion, Arceo), Purok 12 Kabutungan.
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
